This will be a third Joliet-area location alongside stores at Louis Joliet Mall and Orland Square Mall.

data.status: has not announced an opening date
data.short_description: Tipsy Nail Bar is expanding with a new Charlotte location at 2600 Clemson Ave, per a Mecklenburg County zoning record. The brand calls itself "Charlotte's first after hour salon." No opening date has been announced yet, though the zoning approval signals work can move forward.

A new Ross Dress for Less is under construction at 5731 Mercury Drive in Dearborn, the first Ross in Dearborn city limits, near a Target off Ford Road. A recent social media post indicated an opening date around Oct. 10. The company operates around 13 stores in Southeast Michigan.

data.location: 860 Commerce Center Dr, Jacksonville, FL 32225 (within Southside Commons)
data.short_description: NRG Adventure Park is planning to open in the former Bealls space at Southside Commons in Jacksonville's Southside. The indoor adventure/active-play concept will occupy roughly 80,000 square feet. There is currently no opening date posted for the Jacksonville location.

data.status: being built as part of the new terminal expansion
data.short_description: Postcards from Jax, a Jacksonville-themed retail shop, is coming to the airport's new Concourse B. A permit was issued this month for construction, ahead of the Jacksonville Aviation Authority's estimated December 30 opening for the concourse. It's one of four new retail concepts planned for Concourse B.

data.status: An exact opening date for the Solidcore studio has not been announced
data.short_description: Solidcore plans to open its first East Valley studio at Heritage Park in downtown Gilbert, occupying 2,483 square feet. Heritage Park expects its first storefronts to open in Q2 2027, but no exact opening date for Solidcore has been announced.

data.location: 4400 Ashford Dunwoody Rd, Atlanta, GA 30346 (Space 2335, Perimeter Mall)
data.event_date: slated to open in the fall
data.short_description: Alo Yoga will open a new location at Perimeter Mall's Space 2335, marking the brand's fourth Georgia store. It's slated to open this fall, joining existing stores at Lenox Square and Avalon, with another location expected at Ponce City Market this year.
